summary: AI-powered web scraping and browser automation tools have matured significantly by 2026, with LLM-native APIs, natural language queries, and autonomous agent capabilities becoming standard features rather than differentiators. The market has bifurcated into developer-first API platforms like Firecrawl and Apify that return LLM-ready structured data, and managed browser automation runtimes like Browserbase and Playwright that handle dynamic JavaScript-heavy sites. Adoption is heavily driven by the rise of AI agent pipelines, RAG systems, and competitive intelligence dashboards that require reliable, structured web data at scale.

tools.name: Playwright
tools.pricing_paid: Open source / free; cloud providers (e.g., Browserbase) add paid tiers from ~$49/mo
ai_features: AI-assisted selector generation via GitHub Copilot integration
Natural language test and script generation with LLM plugins
Used as base runtime for most AI browser agents
Integrates with AgentQL and other AI query layers

Extensive ecosystem and plugin support
Best-in-class debugging and tracing tools
